Tucson, Arizona before a concert 15th November a few days after his 21st birthday he died (OD). Instead of getting peep help because he was exhausted etc people didn’t really guide him they just pushed him onto stage after stage. They were plying and propping him up with illegal drugs and unprescribed substances. Womack (Liza Womack) was his best friend and Tracy was also like a best friend to him because he didn’t leave his side etc. Peep was born in Allentown, Pennsylvania, the youngest of two sons. He doesn’t like it when people who he isn’t close to call him gus. Peep started taking ballet and tap dance at age 5 and then began to learn hip-hop. He got teased for wanting to dance but his mom encouraged him to dance. Peeps dad left the family when he was 14. His mom was aware of peeps sadness and anxiety when he left high school (senior year). She found out about the very painful experiences much later.
